d:
Jethalal and Taarak Mehta visit the police station to report the stolen wallet containing Dadaji's only photograph. Inspector Chalu Pandey dismisses the urgency after comparing it to higher-priority cases, though Jethalal still files an FIR.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
